name: Ricardo Alonso Vargas
bio: Ricardo Alonso Vargas is a celebrated Peruvian actor, known for his charismatic presence and versatility across film, television, and theatre. His career spans four decades, marked by numerous awards and critical acclaim for his performances in both dramatic and comedic roles. While primarily known for his acting, Ricardo is a passionate motorsport enthusiast, having followed Formula 1 and rally racing since his youth. He owns a vintage collection of cars and occasionally participates in amateur track days. A racing driver might cross paths with Ricardo at a celebrity charity race, a motorsport event in Peru, or even through mutual acquaintances in the entertainment industry. His generosity and connections make him a valuable person to know.
